correctness.rationale: PASS: For every fixed \(r\ge2\), \(n\ge2\), and positive probability profile \(t\), conditional multinomial sampling yields the exact formula \(\operatorname{Cov}(B,K)=s^n F(s)\). The polynomial \(F\) is strictly concave on \((0,1)\), satisfies \(F(0)<0\), \(F(1)=0\), and \(F\prime(1)<0\), and hence has precisely one interior root, with strict signs. Uniform compact-parameter expansions of \((1-xt_i/n)^n\) and \(H\prime(z)>0\) establish the sharp \(O_t(n^{-3})\) remainder for the two-term critical probability. The conditional stochastic-order obstruction follows from strict conditional mean ordering and the attainable \(r+1\) support point when \(n\ge r+1\). Exact independent enumeration passes 48 rational cases, with numerical asymptotics auxiliary rather than infinite proofs.
